name: Root Beer Pie
desc: A frozen root beer pudding and whipped cream filling in a graham cracker crust.

source.title: Root Beer Float Pie
source.evidence: Supplies the pudding box size (3.4 oz) and the 6 oz ready-made graham crust. The site's own ratios (heavy cream, 12 oz root beer, 1 tbsp extract, 1/4 cup milk) are kept.

ingredients.raw: 1 (3.4 oz) box instant vanilla pudding mix

steps: Beat the cream to stiff peaks with a mixer. Refrigerate while you make the pudding.
In a large bowl, whisk the root beer, milk and root beer extract. Sprinkle in the pudding mix and whisk 2 minutes, then let stand 5 minutes to thicken.
Gently fold the whipped cream into the root beer mixture until no streaks remain.
Pour into the crust, cover with the crust's plastic lid, and freeze at least 4 hours, until firm (or refrigerate overnight for a softer pie).
Serve straight from the freezer. Store leftovers frozen.
tips: Most published versions use 3/4 to 1 cup root beer per 3.4 oz box of pudding; with 12 oz this filling stays soft until frozen. Together as Family freezes theirs at least 8 hours.

references.title: Root Beer Float Pie
references.usedFor: whisk then rest the pudding 5 minutes, covering with the crust lid, 8 hour freeze, serving from frozen
